description: Adversarial command-context set: imperative/orchestration verbs (gere/calcule/monte/emita/traduza) are request-form words, not capability classification. COMMAND_POSITIVE cases must reach the governed READ capability; COMMAND_UNSUPPORTED cases must return zero candidates because the semantic topic is outside the governed inventory — never because of the verb itself.

case_types.COMMAND_POSITIVE: command-phrased request whose semantic topic maps to a governed READ capability; expected action must appear (top1 preferred, top3 required)
case_types.COMMAND_UNSUPPORTED: command-phrased request whose semantic topic has no governed capability; zero candidates required
